derivation: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G4198 (πορεύομαι);
def: to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally)

occurrences.text: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.
We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
